An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- storage/icpsr-consortium-archive $.free_tier.stated: ICPSR publishes a deposit cap on its own site: 30 GB and 1,000 files, larger on request. The value's first clause, 'No published byte cap on the curated path', is contradicted; a negotiated larger size is the exception path, not the absence of a cap.
- storage/harvard-dataverse $.identity_cost.kind: The cited page states who may deposit; it never mentions an account, an email or a password. The kind email is stated on guides.dataverse.org/en/latest/user/account.html, which the same record cites for $.identity_cost.detail.
- storage/icpsr-consortium-archive $.identity_cost.kind: The cited page shows deposit is open to anyone, which rules out an institutional gate, but says nothing about the identity an account needs, so email is not stated here. The email-and-password Researcher Passport is on the ICPSR log-in page the record carries for c12.
